items.title: The subsystem generated by an elementary subsystem is elementary, with an explicit ordering
items.author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
items.work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 909-910: if A is an elementary subsystem of an unconfined system then the subsystem generated by A is also elementary, and moreover there is an HF-ordering of it whose closure of A is A. The proof (source lines 911-912) does not take the short route through the closure lemma, and the author says so explicitly; instead it decomposes the generated subsystem into finite stages and uses the elementarity of A at each stage, which is what also produces the isomorphism and hence the ordering with the prescribed closure. The statement records the elementarity and the existence of the ordering, and neither the stage decomposition nor the reason for avoiding the shorter argument.
